batting.name: S Anirudha
batting.dismissal: c Shahid Afridi b RP Singh

batting.dismissal: c RG Sharma b SB Bangar

batting.name: S Badrinath
batting.dismissal: c HH Gibbs b Shahid Afridi

batting.name: MS Dhoni
batting.dismissal: c Shahid Afridi b PP Ojha

batting.dismissal: c S Badrinath b JA Morkel

batting.name: RG Sharma
batting.dismissal: c S Badrinath b M Muralitharan

balls.text: yes he can! the length is too short from Bangar, Morkel gets on to the front foot and pulls the ball powerfully into the gap at deep square leg for four, 20 runs off the final over
full ball outside off stump, Gony stays in his crease and drives towards long off for  a single
another big hit from Gony, Bangar bowls a full toss and Gony hammers it with a powerful swing of the bat and sends it sailing over wide long-on
full ball outside off stump, Gony drives towards deep cover for two more, Afridi is the fielder
or he can do better than that! Gony gets under a full ball and uses all his power to slog the ball miles and miles in the air over midwicket, that is a massive six
Morkel tries to hook a short ball but mis-hits it towards deep backward square leg, Afridi reaches the ball quickly and prevents the second
another one in the block hole, Gony digs it out to backward point, more of a case of ball hitting bat than bat hitting ball, terrific penultimate over from RP, he was consistently in the block hole
RP bowls another ball in the block hole, Gony digs it out hard into the ground and the ball lobs up on the off side

bowled him! Joginder has been backing away towards leg too often, RP replies with the perfect delivery: the leg stump yorker, Joginder tries to squeeze the ball out on the off side but misses, the ball crashes into the base of leg stump
Morkel tries to slog a full ball over midwicket but gets an inside edge that runs behind square for  one more
Joginder backs away to a full ball, RP follows him and Joginder manages to drive  towards long on for  a single
full and right in the block hole, Morkel digs it out back past the bowler for a single
Joginder clears the boundary! He moves towards leg to make room, Styris bowls a short of a length delivery, Joginder pulls and clears the deep midwicket boundary by some distance
a wide full toss outside off stump, Morkel reaches out for it and chips the ball over point
full ball outside off stump, Morkel tries to drive on the off side but misses the ball
massive! Morkel clears his front foot out of the way and slams a full ball straight over Styris's head for another six
good length delivery outside off stump, Morkel sees the room and tries to drive powerfully through cover but mis-times it
Joginder backs away towards leg to make room and slogs the ball to deep backward square leg for a single
Joginder backs away this time and pulls the ball down to long on for  a single to retain strike
Morkel backs away to make room and swats the ball flat towards long off, the ball reaches the fielder on the bounce
Joginder moves towards the off side and tries to pull, he gets an inside edge on to the pad and they run a single to the off side
Morkel goes down on one knee and pulls him along the ground to deep midwicket

they need a new ball for Morkel has smashed it out of the MA Chidambaram Stadium, it is measured at 124 meters, Morkel cleared his front foot out of the way and pulled a short ball over deep midwicket, it went over the roof
bowled flat through the air on middle stump, Morkel moves back and pulls to deep midwicket where there is nearly another mix-up between two fielders
Morkel plays the ball off his pads behind square for  one
driven down the ground towards long off for a single

Joginder backs away towards leg to make room, Afridi follows him but Joginder manages to connect with the slog sweep towards deep midwicket, RP runs to field the ball but over runs it carelessly and concedes four
good length delivery on middle and leg, played off the pads towards short fine leg
played to deep midwicket for  a single
driven off the front foot towards cover,  an over throw at the keeper's end allows the single
defended on the back foot towards point

and he has got him! Dhoni's struggle ends, he got squared up and tried to pull a flat delivery through square leg, he got a bottom edge on to his pad and the ball lobbed up all the way towards Afridi at point, another simple catch and Chennai are sinking, actually Dhoni hit the ball on to his pad and hit it once again during the follow through of his shot as the ball bounced off his thigh
Morkel works the ball off his pads through midwicket for a single
Dhoni moves forward and gets squared up and collects a single via an outside edge on the off side
Dhoni once again gets hit on the pad as he tried to flick on the on side
Dhoni comes forward and tries to hit the ball on the leg side but gets struck on the pad

full and wide outside off stump, Morkel reaches out for it and drives the ball powerfully over cover, RP dives on the boundary and stops it, he then goes over the rope but manages to come back in and save the four, good effort on the boundary, the third umpire is called but RP has done a clean job
the slower ball bowled at 100 kmh on middle and off, Morkel comes forward and pushes it back to Bangar
Bangar greets him with a bouncer from over the wicket, Morkel ducks under it

what a soft dismissal! Bangar goes round the wicket and delivers a low full toss outside off stump, Raina drives at it and chips the ball in the air and straight to Sharma at cover, Raina's gone after getting well set
that's a low full toss, Bangar was perhaps attempting the yorker, Dhoni drives towards long-on for one
excellent length on off and middle stump, Dhoni can't do much but play the ball back firmly towards the bowler off the front foot
tight wicket-to-wicket line from Ojha, Dhoni moves back and pushes the ball towards long on for  a single to retain strike
bowled full outside the off stump, Raina moves forward and drives through cover for one
driven to long off for a single
Dhoni moves back once again to cut but there isn't enough room, he plays it towards cover once again
Dhoni moves back to a flat and straight delivery and pushes it towards cover
Raina moves back and across and nudges the ball off his pads towards midwicket for a single
tight line and length on middle stump from over the wicket, Raina drives straight down the ground to retain strike
short ball on off and middle stump, Dhoni pulls the ball along the ground to deep backward square leg for a single
good length delivery on off stump, punched off the front foot through cover for  a single
the slower ball angled into the left-hander from round the wicket, Raina backs away to make room and tries to smash it over the off side, he gets beaten and the ball misses leg stump
defended on the leg side

that's a high skier but it falls safe and goes for four! Raina got under a full ball and smashed it high in the air towards long-on, Styris ran back from mid-on an the ball just fell out of his reach and went over the boundary on the one-bounce
bowled flat through the air on leg stump, Dhoni tries to work the ball on the leg side and gets hit on the pad
he fires the ball into Dhoni's pads after pitching outside leg, Dhoni once again misses the paddle sweep
loud appeal for a caught behind but the ball had slipped down leg side and Benson calls it wide, Gilchrist was quite confident after Dhoni missed the paddle sweep
tight length on middle stump, Dhoni waits in hi crease and defends towards midwicket
bowled flatter fuller and straighter, Dhoni leans forward and blocks
bowled flat outside the off stump, Dhoni moves on to the back foot and cuts to the fielder on the point boundary, both Dhoni and Raina are very quick and they come back for two
played off the pads through midwicket for a single
short of a length outside off stump, Dhoni moves back and pulls the ball straight down the ground, he's hit it very straight and will come back for  a quick second
good length delivery angling into off stump, Dhoni plays from his crease and defends towards cover
short of a length and wide outside off stump, Dhoni moves back and cuts the ball through cover, Venugopal runs to his right from sweeper and fields
Bangar strays down leg side, Dhoni leans forward and across his stumps and glances the ball towards fine leg
a short ball on middle and leg stump, Dhoni tries to pull along the ground but gets a bit of glove on it, the ball goes towards the keeper on the bounce
good length delivery on off stump, Dhoni steps out of his crease and defends
a bit too short outside off stump, Raina moves back and hits the ball with a flat bat straight past the bowler for four, excellent placement
Dhoni leans forward and pushes a flat delivery towards cover
fuller length, defended towards point off the front foot
short and wide outside off, Dhoni moves back and cuts hard into the gap at backward point, he played that late and powerfully
Dhoni runs down the track at Afridi who sees him coming and fires the ball towards the leg side, Dhoni gets hit on the pad
bowled full on middle stump, Raina moves forward and drives towards mid-on

tight line and length from Styris outside off stump, Raina punches off the front foot towards mid-off and sprints the single, the overthrow goes towards fine leg but Raina had run a long way past his stumps and couldn't take advantage of it
good length from Styris outside off stump, Dhoni moves back and across and punches the ball in front of point for one
Dhoni moves forward and opens the face of the bat at the last moment to steer a short of a length ball past first slip for four
Styris bowls the short ball over middle and leg stump, Dhoni thinks about pulling but moves inside the line of the ball and lets it go in the end
good length from Styris on off stump, Dhoni gets behind the line on the back foot and defends towards the off side
a bit too short outside off stump, Rania waits on the back foot and cuts to the man on the point boundary
bowled flat and fast on off stump, Dhoni defends back to the bowler

what a catch! It's Gibbs this time! Afridi bowled a poor ball, it was extremely short and very wide, Badrinath chased it and tried to cut without much power behind the shot, he connected with the bottom of the bat and hit it in the air, the ball might have carried to short third man but it never got the chance, Gibbs moved quickly to his left from backward point and dived full length to take the catch, outstanding athleticism
slightly slower delivery outside the right-hander's off stump, defended on the front foot on the off side
fuller and straighter from Afridi, driven down the ground for one
and again, this time Rania moved across his stumps to a leg-side delivery and paddled the ball to the fine leg boundary
too short from Afridi, he dragged it down and Raina had more time than he needed to pull the ball to the deep square leg boundary
good length delivery on off stump, Badrinath gets behidn the line and defends on the off side, three runs and a wicket off Styris' first over
another short ball outside off stump, Badrinath tries to steer it down to third man but gets beaten by the high bounce
banged in short first up, Badrinath sways out of the way and the leg-umpire calls it wide for height

a blinder at cover point! The length was full outside the off stump, Fleming came forward and smashed the square drive in the air, he hit that so hard that the ball travelled extremely quickly to Sharma who jumped up and took the catch with both hands
Rania moves forward and nudges a good length ball towards the leg side for  a single
the short ball angles across Fleming and he attempts to pull it, he hasn't connected well but the ball falls safely in front of the fielder at deep midwicket
short of a length on off and middle stump, Fleming stays on the back foot and defends on the leg side
too full on middle stump, Rania moves forward and drives the ball in the air back over the bowler's head for four, he didn't hit it very hard but placed it superbly
Fleming came forward to hoist the ball off his pads behind square but the length wasn't full enough, the ball pitched outside leg and hit him on the pad
too full outside the off stump, it is a half volley, Fleming strides forward and dispatches the ball through covers with a full flourish of the bat
loud appeal for lbw, it was a low swinging full toss and Fleming missed the flick, he looked like he got an inside edge on to the pad
straighter line on middle and off stump, Rania pushes the ball towards mid-off and sets off for the quick single
fullish length outside the off stump, Rania steps forward and punches the ball towards cover
poor line, RP pitches short of a length and angles the ball into Fleming's pads, he leans across and glances the ball down to fine leg for his first boundary
banged in short but the line is down leg side, Fleming can't connect with the pull, another wide
a full delivery angles into Fleming who moves forward and drives the ball back towards the bowler
Raina gets off the mark by flicking the ball off his pads towards deep square leg

caught! RP sends down a short ball, Anirudha tries to pull off the front foot from outside off stump, he was in no position whatsoever and top-edges it high in the air to Afridi at cover point, that is a simple catch and Chennai have lost two early wickets once again
a good length ball pitches around off stump and nips back into the right-hander, Anirudha gets behind the line on the front foot and defends back to the bowler
Anirudha comes forward to drive the ball through the off side, hardly any footwork and the ball keeps low and beats the bat
short and extremely wide outside off stump, Anirudha chases it with a wild slash but the ball is too far away from him
good length delivery on middle and off stump, Fleming tries to drive but gets an inside edge on to the pad
played off the pads towards midwicket, Fleming is unable to find the gaps here

dropped, but a fantastic effort, Fleming moved forward and tried to drive a ball that was seaming across him through cover, he got a thick outside edge that flew into the gap between Gilchrist and Bangar who was at a wide slip, Bangar dived to his right and got a hand to it but couldn't hold on
good length delivery on off stump, Fleming strides forward and defends to Gibbs at point
a bit too straight this time, Fleming moves across and flicks off the front foot through square leg for two
terrific line, Vijay Kumar slants the ball away from Fleming from over the wicket, the ball pitches on a good length around off stump, drawing Fleming forward and then seams past his outside edge
short of a length delivery angling into middle and leg, Fleming nudges off his hips towards square leg
excellent ball, pitches on a good length around off stump and seams away from the left-hander, Fleming pushes at it and gets beaten
short of a length delivery outside off, cut down towards third man to get off the mark
RP pitches one on middle and leg and slants down leg side, Anirudha tries to play the leg glance but gets hit on the pad for four leg byes
short of a length ball angling across the right-hander from over the wicket, Anirudha tries to cut but the ball is too close to him, he gets beaten by the pace and bounce

caught this time! Vijay Kumar bangs in the short ball, Parthiv takes him on and plays the hook, the ball hits the top edge and flies extremely high in the air towards long leg, RP Singh sprints to his right from fine leg and covers a lot of ground to get to the ball, he takes a supremely judged catch while on the run

dropped! Parthiv gives Vijay Kumar the charge and tries to smash the ball straight, he mis-hit it and connected with the top half of the bat and played the ball straight to the bowler who couldn't hold on during his follow through
short of a length delivery outside off, defended towards Rohit Sharma at cover

short of a length outside off stump, Parthiv moves on to the back foot and cuts hard towards point where Afridi mis-fields to allow the boundary, I do hope the fielding will be better than it was last night
good length ball outside the off stump, Parthiv stays in his crease and pushes the ball towards cover point

a full ball swings into the left-hander from round the wicket, Parthiv moves forward and across and tries to flick, he misses and gets hit on the pad, loud appeal for leg before but umpire Benson says not out, Benson goes down the pitch and inspects the bowler's follow through

absolutely zero! Afridi hooks a short ball and gets a top edge over short fine leg, the ball bounces inside the boundary but runs over the rope, actually it might be given as a single if the batsmen crossed before the ball went over the boundary, nope it has been declared a four
there are six of them! the length is full once again and Afridi slogs it high and far over deep midwicket, the scores are level
full toss on the pads, Afridi moves across and nudges the ball off his pads towards the fine leg boundary
well he's smashed him now! Afridi sees the full length and blasts the ball over the  extra cover boudnary on the front foot, he didn't time it perfectly but it still went the distance
well I lost that one, Joginder bowled a bouncer and Afridi tamely ducked under it
a full ball swings into styris who opens the face and runs the ball towards third man off the front foot
it's Murali's last ball and Afridi decides to defend it watchfully off the front foot
Styris moves forward and drives through point for one
defended on the front foot towards the off side
Styris misses the flick and gets hit on the pad once again
Murali fires the ball down leg side, Styris misses the flick, that is a wide
another doosra on off stump, Styris defends off the front foot to the off side

Sharma's holed out! He stepped out of his crease and was looking to loft the ball over deep midwicket, it was the doosra from Murali and Sharma got a thick leading edge that swirled high in the air towards Badrinath who settles under the catch at long on

that is high and six! Styris backs away towards the leg side, Morkel follows him and Styris gets under the length ball and lofts the ball high over deep midwicket, it didn't clear the boundary by much but it went miles in the air
full length on middle and leg, Sharma leans forward and flicks off his pads towards long leg
Stryis latches on to a short ball and pulls towards deep square leg, Deccan are cruising here
Sharma plants his front foot forward and lofts the ball across the line towards deep square leg
Sharma moves across his stumps and tries to hook a quick short ball, he takes his eyes off the ball and gets hit squarely on the helmet
Styris makes room by moving towards the leg side and drives towards long off
a full ball angles into off and middle stump, Styris stays in his crease and swings the ball through midwicket for a single
a higher full toss this time, Sharma flicks it off his hips for a single to square leg
bowled full into the block hole outside off stump, Styris digs the ball out towards the off side
Ntini goes wide of the crease and bowls a full toss, Styris drives the ball firmly towards long off
fuller length outside of stump, Styris moves forward and drives towards point
short of a length outside off stump, Styris moves back and plays the ball towards point
short ball and Sharma swivels and pulls with such power that deep square leg has no chance to cut it off
defended on the leg side

lovely shot, Sharma backed away towards the leg side to make room, Joginder bowled a slower ball just short of a length, Sharma hits through the line and lofts the ball effortlessly over the straight boundary, Sharma reclaims the orange cap with that six
another short ball, Sharma came forward and tried to pull, the ball got big on him and he stopped his shot
Sharma tries to make room by moving towards the leg side but gets cramped for room by a delivery in the block hole
Joginder starts with a short ball and Styris pulls the ball powerfully to deep backward square leg
played behind point with an open face for a single
Styris charges Murali and drives him powerfully towards the big gap at wide long-on, he's timed and placed it beautifully
Sharma gets down on one knee and sweeps towards deep backward square leg
defended to midwicket on the front foot
full ball on leg stump, styris goes right back and tries to flick but misses and gets hit on the pad, Murali appeals for lbw but it was missing leg
that's the doosra on middle stump, Styris pushes it towards point off the front foot
a bit too straight from Morkel on middle and length, the length is fuller as well, Styris goes back and flicks to deep backward square leg
good length on middle stump once again, Styris gets behind the line and defends
quick delivery angling into off stump, Styris moves forward and defends towards point
fuller length on off stump, defended on the front foot towards the off side
the length is short once again, Styris swivels and pulls the ball in front of square for four, he's placed it perfectly between deep midwicket and deep backward square leg
banged in short by Morkel, Sharma pulls off the front foot towards deep backward square leg
bowled flat through the air on off stump, Styris moves forward and drives back to the bowler
pushed towards midwicket for a single
Sharma moves across his stumps to sweep and gets a faint bit of bat on it past Dhoni, he's placed it fine and Parthiv's chase from short fine leg is in vain
Styris moves forward and flicks the ball towards midwicket, he's getting his front pad outside the line of off stump

Sharma had no idea what was going on, he leaned forward and closed the face to play the ball on the leg side, he was looking for the off break but it was the doosra which turned away from him and took the leading edge past slip, Parthiv does well to save the boundary at third man
bowled flat through the air on middle stump, Styris moves across and flicks the ball off his pads towards long leg
short of a length delivery outside off stump, Sharma stays on the back foot and plays the ball to point

short, wide, cut and caught! Gilchrist threw his bat hard at a wide ball and cuts it hard but straight to Badrinath at point, he didn't have to move for the catch but did well to hold on to it for it was hit extremely hard
short of a length outside off stump, Styris guides the ball to third man with an open face
banged in short by Morkel, Styris lets it go, that was quick
defended on the back foot by Styris towards the bowler
short of a length delivery outside off stump, Styris defends on the back foot towards point, Gilchrist wants the single but gets sent back
Murali strays down leg side, Gilchrist moves back and nudges the ball past Dhoni for a delicate boundary, now that is a first for his innings
that is the doosra but the length is a little short which allows Styris to push it towards point on the back foot
Styris tries to drive on the off side but Murali beats the bat with the straighter one
Styris moves forward and gets his front pad outside the line of off stump and nudges the ball to the leg side
Gilchrist gets to fifty by tapping the ball towards long-on for a single, the Chennai crowd rises to applaud Gilchrist, he's been entertaining from the start
bowled flat through the air on off stump, Gilchrist moves forward and blocks
good length delivery on middle stump, Gilchrist plays it off his pads towards mdiwicket, that wasn't the 7th ball off the over, there was another no ball in the over apparently
Gilchrist tried to pull it through midwicket once again but it was the slower ball and he was beaten by the lack of pace
fuller ball on middle and leg, Styris plays it off his pads towards fine leg
defended on the back foot towards the bowler

that was about the decapitate the umpire, Styris planted his front foot forward and slammed the straight drive right at Benson who ducked out of the way in a hurry, needless to say no fielder got close to it
Gilchrist swings the free hit over midwicket and gets just the single
Gilchrist moves forward and drills the cover drive powerfully though extra cover, nobody moved, nobody could move, Joginder had overstepped as well
full ball outside off stump, Gilchrist reaches out for it and drives towards cover
bowled full on middle and leg stump, Gilchrist drives the ball towards mid-on for one
good length delivery outside off stump, Styris plays the square drive towards point
fuller length on off stump, Styris drives towards cover off the front foot
short of a length outside off stump, Gilchrist steers the ball towards third man for one
short and wide outside off stump, Gilchrist moves back and cuts fiercely past point for four, that was hit with phenomenal speed
a full delivery angles into off and middle stump, Styris pushes the ball off the front foot towards mid-on for  a single
Ntini fires it in full and fast on the pads, Gilchrist moves across and flicks the ball towards long leg to bring up Deccan's 50
Styris moves back and nudges a short of a length ball towards third man for  a single
Gilchrist once again drives the ball firmly straight down the ground but Ntini has  along-on in place now
Gilchrist is laying into Ntini, Gilchrist plants his front foot forward and lofts the ball cleanly over mid-on, he's hit it better than the last one for this time he clears the boundary
full once again angling into the left-hander, Gilchrist hits through the line and lofts the ball straight over the bowler's head for four
not much it seems, too full on the pads, poor line to Gilchrist, he stands in his crease and lofts the ball off his pads over the midwicket boundary

this time he calls for the risky single and that might have been close, Gilchrist drove a full ball firmly to Murali at mid-off and called Styris through, Murali's throw missed the stumps at the bowler's end
good length delivery angles into Gilchrist's off stump, he strides forward and drives past the bowler to mid-off
that is too short and Gilchrist will feed on that length even in the worst of form, he rocks back transferring weight on to the back foot and pulls the ball over midwicket for four
good length once again on off stump, Gilchrist waits in his crease and defends towards the off side
he gets off the mark by working a short of a length ball off his hips behind square on the leg side

caught! and superbly caught! Gony pitches the ball on a good length and angles it into the right-hander, Gibbs steps out of his crease and gets cramped for room by the angle of the delivery into him, he pushes at the ball with a straight bat and hits it off the middle but straight back to Gony who holds a sharp catch on his follow through
driven firmly off the front foot towards cover

that is an odd shot, Gilchrist moved across his stumps, looking to pull the ball through midwicket, the ball came on to him quicker than he expected and Gilchrist played the pull shot past mid-off for four
fuller length on middle stump, Gilchrist moves forward and swings the ball to midwicket

that's just a bit short again, Gilchrist moves swiftly on to the back foot and pulls the ball towards Murali's left at mid-on, he can't get down quickly enough and the ball runs to the long-on boundary
full and wide outside of once again, Gilchrist moves forward and tries to play the square drive but mis-times it to point
Morkel sprays it full and wide across the left-hander, Gilchrist lets it go and a wide is called
good length ball on off stump, Gilchrist defends on the back foot on the off side
that's just a fraction short and that's all Gibbs needs to get into position on the front foot and pull the ball over midwicket for four
good length delivery angling into the right-hander, Gibbs moves forward and plays the ball towards point
short of a length on middle stump, Gibbs defends off his hips towards square leg
shot! Gibbs steps out of his crease and tees off, he swings his bat powerfully and smashes the ball over the cover boundary, awesome
Ntini bowls a fuller ball on off and middle stump, Gibbs uses the angle into him and leans across his stumps to play the ball to square leg
good length from Ntini, angling the ball across Gilchrist's middle stump, he comes forward and pushes the ball towards mid-on for  a single
good length from Gony on off stump, he has no trouble adjusting his line to the right-hander, Gibbs defends on the back foot towards point, just one run off the over, fabulous
Gilchrist moves back to defend a short of a length delivery from off stump and gets a thick outside edge towards third man
good length from Gony on middle and off, Gilchrist tries to drive but doesn't have the length or room to work with, he plays it back to the bowler, four dot balls to Gilchrist, extremely impressive
that's not that short but Gilchrist tries to get under it and pull over midwicket, he mis-times it to the fielder
fuller length on middle and off stump, Gilchrist moves forward and plays the square drive towards point
short of a length delivery outside off stump, Gilchrist moves back and drives towards mid-off
Ntini appeals for lbw but Gibbs has got an inside edge, he came forward to defend an incoming delivery from outside off and got a thick inside edge on to the pad
tight line and length on off stump, Gibbs strides forward and defends back to the bowler, Ntini moves to his right and fields
Gibbs leans forward and drives a good length ball from off stump towards point
the line is a bit too straight on leg and middle, the length is good length and Gilchrist plays the ball off his pads towards long leg
good length delivery pitches outside off stump and seams across the left-hander, Gilchrist moves back and lifts his bat out of the way
full ball on the pads, Gilchrist flicks the ball off his pads through midwicket for two
